items.q: The price of a laptop is raised by 25% and then the new price is reduced by 20%. The final price compared to the original is
items.explain: 1.25 x 0.80 = 1.00, so the two changes cancel exactly; adding percentages (+25 - 20) is the common mistake.

items.q: In a company, A : B = 2 : 3 and B : C = 4 : 5 for three salaries. What is A : B : C?
items.explain: Make B common: multiply the first ratio by 4 and the second by 3, giving 8 : 12 and 12 : 15.

items.q: Priya can finish a report in 12 days and Arjun in 18 days. Working together, how many days will they take?
items.explain: Combined rate = 1/12 + 1/18 = 5/36 per day, so the job takes 36/5 = 7.2 days.

items.q: Two fair six-sided dice are rolled. What is the probability that the sum is 9?
items.explain: The favourable pairs are (3,6), (4,5), (5,4), (6,3), so 4 out of 36 = 1/9.

items.q:
The eigenvalues of the matrix

[ 4  1 ]
[ 2  3 ]

are
items.explain: Trace = 7 and determinant = 10, so the eigenvalues satisfy x^2 - 7x + 10 = 0, giving 2 and 5; the diagonal entries are eigenvalues only for triangular matrices.

items.q: For f(x) = x^3 - 3x, the local minimum occurs at
items.explain: f'(x) = 3x^2 - 3 = 0 at x = +/-1, and f''(x) = 6x is positive at x = 1, so that is the minimum (x = -1 is the maximum).

items.q: Evaluate the integral of 3x^2 dx from x = 0 to x = 2.
items.explain: The antiderivative is x^3, so the value is 2^3 - 0^3 = 8.

items.q:
Choose the correct word to fill the blank:

Neither of the two designs ____ acceptable to the client.
items.explain: 'Neither' is singular, so it takes the singular verb 'is' even though it refers to two things.

items.q: The average of five numbers is 20. If the number 30 is removed, what is the average of the remaining four?
items.explain: Total = 5 x 20 = 100; removing 30 leaves 70 across four numbers, so 70/4 = 17.5.

items.q:
The rank of the matrix

[ 1  2  3 ]
[ 2  4  6 ]
[ 1  1  1 ]

is
items.explain: Row 2 is twice row 1, so only two rows are linearly independent and the rank is 2.

items.q:
Statements: All engineers are graduates. No graduate is a minor.

Which conclusion definitely follows?
items.explain: Every engineer is inside the set of graduates, and that set has no overlap with minors, so no engineer can be a minor.
